Stone slinger & gravel delivery in Larder Lake, ON

Bulk gravel, sand and topsoil placed at Larder Lake homes, camps and lots, including spots with tight access.

What we do in Larder Lake

  • Camp road and parking gravel
  • Septic and drainage stone
  • Topsoil for new lawns
  • Sand fill and bedding

We cover Larder Lake and nearby Virginiatown, Kearns and the Highway 66 corridor. The slinger places material up to 100 ft from the road or driveway, so tight lots and long laneways are no problem.

Larder Lake FAQ

Do you serve Larder Lake?

Yes. We serve Larder Lake, including Virginiatown, Kearns and the Highway 66 corridor. Call (705) 622-3373 for a quote.

What can you place in Larder Lake?
